reuse.why: Calls the shared building blocks (assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse) but the link and download flows are copied from the Pluggy.ai provider rather than factored into a shared provider-parameterised function.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkPluggyAiAccount (~80 lines) and downloadFintegraTransactions a verbatim copy of downloadPluggyAiTransactions, differing only in the provider string, bank key and server URL.

placement.why: Each piece lands where its siblings are: link handler and registration in accounts/app.ts, download and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config, provider list and type in types/models.

scope.why: Focused on the server-side provider; the two desktop-client edits are forced by the Record<BankSyncProviders, ...> types rather than unrelated.

maintainability.why: A sixth copy of the per-provider link and download boilerplate means any fix to linking or download handling must be repeated per provider again.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The tree has no shared provider-generic link or download function to go through; the change follows the existing per-provider pattern.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies are verbatim with names swapped (Pluggy.ai -> Fintegra), not reshaped.
